versos.grego: Τότε ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀνήχθη εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ὑπὸ τοῦ Πνεύματος, πειρασθῆναι ὑπὸ τοῦ διαβόλου.

controles.web: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
controles.kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
controles.livre: Então Jesus foi levado pelo Espírito ao deserto para ser tentado pelo diabo.

versos.grego: καὶ νηστεύσας ἡμέρας τεσσεράκοντα καὶ τεσσεράκοντα νύκτας ὕστερον ἐπείνασεν.

controles.web: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.
controles.kjv: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
controles.livre: E depois de jejuar quarenta dias e quarenta noites, teve fome.

versos.grego: καὶ προσελθὼν ὁ πειράζων εἶπεν αὐτῷ Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ, εἰπὲ ἵνα οἱ λίθοι οὗτοι ἄρτοι γένωνται.

controles.web: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”
controles.kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
controles.livre: E o tentador se aproximou, e disse-lhe: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, dize que estas pedras se tornem pães.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Γέγραπται Οὐκ ἐπ’ ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ὁ ἄνθρωπος, ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ παντὶ ῥήματι ἐκπορευομένῳ διὰ στόματος Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.’”
controles.kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus respondeu: Está escrito: Não só de pão viverá o ser humano, mas de toda palavra que sai da boca de Deus.

versos.grego: Τότε παραλαμβάνει αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος εἰς τὴν ἁγίαν πόλιν, καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ πτερύγιον τοῦ ἱεροῦ,

controles.web: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,
controles.kjv: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
controles.livre: Então o diabo o levou consigo à santa cidade, e o pôs sobre o ponto mais alto do Templo,

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Εἰ Υἱὸς εἶ τοῦ Θεοῦ, βάλε σεαυτὸν κάτω· γέγραπται γὰρ ὅτι Τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσίν σε, μή ποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου.

controles.web: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you.’ and,  ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”
controles.kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe: Se tu és o Filho de Deus, lança-te abaixo, porque está escrito que: Mandará a seus anjos acerca de ti, e te tomarão pelas mãos, para que nunca com teu pé tropeces em pedra alguma.

versos.grego: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πάλιν γέγραπται Οὐκ ἐκπειράσεις Κύριον τὸν Θεόν σου.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”
controles.kjv: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
controles.livre: Jesus lhe disse: Também está escrito: Não tentarás  o Senhor teu Deus.

versos.grego: Πάλιν παραλαμβάνει αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος εἰς ὄρος ὑψηλὸν λίαν, καὶ δείκνυσιν αὐτῷ πάσας τὰς βασιλείας τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν,

controles.web: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.
controles.kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
controles.livre: Outra vez o diabo o levou consigo a um monte muito alto, e lhe mostrou todos os reinos do mundo, e a glória deles,

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ταῦτά σοι πάντα δώσω, ἐὰν πεσὼν προσκυνήσῃς μοι.

controles.web: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”
controles.kjv: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe: Tudo isto te darei se, prostrado, me adorares.

versos.grego: τότε λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὕπαγε, Σατανᾶ· γέγραπται γάρ Κύριον τὸν θεόν σου προσκυνήσεις καὶ αὐτῷ μόνῳ λατρεύσεις.

controles.web: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me,Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”
controles.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
controles.livre: Então Jesus disse: Vai embora, Satanás! Porque está escrito: Ao Senhor teu Deus adorarás, e só a ele cultuarás.

versos.grego: Τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτὸν ὁ διάβολος, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄγγελοι προσῆλθον καὶ διηκόνουν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.
controles.kjv: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
controles.livre: Então o diabo o deixou; e eis que chegaram anjos, e o serviram.

versos.grego: Ἀκούσας δὲ ὅτι Ἰωάνης παρεδόθη ἀνεχώρησεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

controles.web: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.
controles.kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
controles.livre: Mas quando Jesus ouviu que João estava preso, voltou para a Galileia.

versos.grego: καὶ καταλιπὼν τὴν Ναζαρὰ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ τὴν παραθαλασσίαν ἐν ὁρίοις Ζαβουλὼν καὶ Νεφθαλείμ·

controles.web: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
controles.kjv: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
controles.livre: E deixando Nazaré, veio a morar em Cafarnaum, cidade marítima, nos limites de Zebulom e Naftali,

versos.grego: ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος

controles.web: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,
controles.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
controles.livre: para que se cumprisse o que foi anunciado pelo profeta Isaías, que disse:

versos.grego: Γῆ Ζαβουλὼν καὶ γῆ Νεφθαλείμ, ὁδὸν θαλάσσης, πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου, Γαλιλαία τῶν ἐθνῶν,

controles.web: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
controles.kjv: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
controles.livre: A terra de Zebulom e a terra de Naftali, caminho do mar, além do Jordão, a Galileia dos gentios;

versos.grego: ὁ λαὸς ὁ καθήμενος ἐν σκοτίᾳ φῶς εἶδεν μέγα, καὶ τοῖς καθημένοις ἐν χώρᾳ καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου φῶς ἀνέτειλεν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”
controles.kjv: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
controles.livre: O povo sentado em trevas viu uma grande luz; aos sentados em região e sombra da morte, a luz lhes apareceu.

versos.grego: Ἀπὸ τότε ἤρξατο ὁ Ἰησοῦς κηρύσσειν καὶ λέγειν Μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.

controles.web: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”
controles.kjv: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
controles.livre: Desde então Jesus começou a pregar e a dizer: Arrependei-vos, porque perto está o Reino dos céus.

versos.grego: Περιπατῶν δὲ παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν δύο ἀδελφούς, Σίμωνα τὸν λεγόμενον Πέτρον καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, βάλλοντας ἀμφίβληστρον εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν· ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλεεῖς.

controles.web: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.
controles.kjv: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
controles.livre: Enquanto Jesus andava junto ao mar da Galileia, viu dois irmãos: Simão, chamado Pedro, e seu irmão André, lançarem a rede ao mar, porque eram pescadores.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου, καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς ἁλεεῖς ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”
controles.kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: Vinde após mim, e eu vos farei pescadores de gente.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εὐθέως ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: They immediately left their nets and followed him.
controles.kjv: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
controles.livre: Então eles logo deixaram as redes e o seguiram.

versos.grego: Καὶ προβὰς ἐκεῖθεν εἶδεν ἄλλους δύο ἀδελφούς, Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάνην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ Ζεβεδαίου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα αὐτῶν· καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς.

controles.web: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.
controles.kjv: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
controles.livre: E passando dali, viu outros dois irmãos: Tiago, filho de Zebedeu, e seu irmão João, em um barco, com seu pai Zebedeu, que estavam consertando suas redes; e ele os chamou.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ εὐθέως ἀφέντες τὸ πλοῖον καὶ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.
controles.kjv: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
controles.livre: E eles logo deixaram o barco e seu pai, e o seguiram.

versos.grego: Καὶ περιῆγεν ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ, διδάσκων ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς βασιλείας καὶ θεραπεύων πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν ἐν τῷ λαῷ.

controles.web: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.
controles.kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
controles.livre: E Jesus rodeava toda a Galileia, ensinando em suas sinagogas, pregando o Evangelho do Reino, e curando toda enfermidade e toda doença no povo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν Συρίαν· καὶ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις καὶ βασάνοις συνεχομένους, δαιμονιζομένους καὶ σεληνιαζομένους καὶ παραλυτικούς, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτούς.

controles.web: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.
controles.kjv: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
controles.livre: Sua fama corria por toda a Síria, e traziam-lhe todos que sofriam de algum mal, tendo diversas enfermidades e tormentos, e os endemoninhados, epiléticos, e paralíticos; e ele os curava.

versos.grego: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοὶ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ Δεκαπόλεως καὶ Ἱεροσολύμων καὶ Ἰουδαίας καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.

controles.web: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.
controles.kjv: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judea, and from beyond Jordan.
controles.livre: E muitas multidões da Galileia, de Decápolis, de Jerusalém, da Judeia, e dalém do Jordão o seguiam.
